newsitem.title: USA: Uroquest to test catheter in France.
newsitem.headline: Uroquest to test catheter in France.

text.p: UroQuest Medical Corp said Monday that the French Ministry of Health has granted approval to begin clinical testing of its On-Command intraurethral catheter for men in France.
The On-Command catheter is an intraurethral device designed to manage voiding dysfunction through the use of a novel patient-controlled valve that regulates urine flow.
The company said it expects to begin testing in May through a clinical testing agreement with B. Braun Biotrol SA, which will conduct and fund the test under the direction of UroQuest.
UroQuest is currently conducting clinical trials for the Male and Female versions of the On-Command catheter in the United States.
